events.title: Greeks defeat the Persian army at Plataea
events.description: A Greek alliance led by Sparta defeated the Persian army of Mardonius at Plataea, on a date traditionally placed in late August. The victory ended Persia's invasion of mainland Greece.
events.html: A Greek alliance led by Sparta defeated the Persian army of Mardonius at Plataea, on a date traditionally placed in late August. The victory ended Persia's invasion of mainland Greece.

events.title: British forces defeat Washington at the Battle of Long Island
events.description: General William Howe outflanked and routed the Continental Army in Brooklyn, the largest battle of the war. Two nights later Washington's army escaped across the East River.
events.html: General William Howe outflanked and routed the Continental Army in Brooklyn, the largest battle of the war. Two nights later Washington's army escaped across the East River.

events.title: Edwin Drake strikes oil in Pennsylvania
events.description: Drilling near Titusville, Edwin Drake's well struck oil at about 21 metres. It was the first commercially successful oil well in the US and launched the modern petroleum industry.
events.html: Drilling near Titusville, Edwin Drake's well struck oil at about 21 metres. It was the first commercially successful oil well in the US and launched the modern petroleum industry.

events.title: Fifteen nations sign the Kellogg-Briand Pact
events.description: Signatories in Paris renounced war as an instrument of national policy. The pact had no means of enforcement, but it later underpinned charges of crimes against peace at Nuremberg.
events.html: Signatories in Paris renounced war as an instrument of national policy. The pact had no means of enforcement, but it later underpinned charges of crimes against peace at Nuremberg.

events.title: The Heinkel He 178 makes the first jet-powered flight
events.description: Test pilot Erich Warsitz flew the Heinkel He 178 at Rostock-Marienehe, the first flight of an aircraft powered by a turbojet. Days later Germany invaded Poland.
events.html: Test pilot Erich Warsitz flew the Heinkel He 178 at Rostock-Marienehe, the first flight of an aircraft powered by a turbojet. Days later Germany invaded Poland.
